demandSubtitle: Chhooti demand yaad rakho. Maal mangao aur asal recovered sales dekho.
recoveredHint: Sirf linked confirmed invoices ki discount ke baad ki rakam. Cancelled sales shamil nahi hain.
peopleHint: Batayi gayi logon ki sankhya optional hai. Yeh pehchane hue customers ya maangi gayi units ki ginti nahi hai.
permission: Customer ne iss request par baat karne ki permission di hai
consentHint: Sirf mili permission darj karo. Message apne aap nahi jaata.
requestSaved: Request darj hui. Stock aur sales nahi badle.
noDemandHint: Jo customer ko nahi mila, yahan note karo. Yeh sale se alag hai.
noReservation: Stock reserve nahi hota. Kai requests ek hi available stock ke liye ho sakti hain.
draftHint: Sirf planning hai. Supplier order nahi bhejta; goods receive confirm hone tak stock nahi badalta.
receiptHint: Goods aa jaayein tabhi confirm karo. Isse purchase aur stock receipt darj hoti hai.
copied: Copy ho gaya. Recipient khud chuno.
followupHint: Customer se sach mein contact karne ke baad hi mark karo. Draft banana ya copy karna contact nahi hai.
linkHint: Matching confirmed invoice chuno. Units aur revenue ek hi baar link ho sakte hain.
associateHint: Same unit aur exact saved variant chuno. Dusre size ka stock yeh request poori nahi karega.
voiceHint: Browser speech vendor servers use kar sakta hai. Draft review karo; customer count product quantity nahi hai.
missingQuantity: Maangi quantity nahi mili. Save se pehle asal quantity daalo.
micUnsupported: Yahan microphone recognition nahi hai. Request type karo.
micFailed: Microphone ruk gaya ya available nahi hai. Text abhi bhi edit kar sakte ho.
featuresHint: Zaroori modules dikhao. Sales, stock aur customer records role ke mutabik available rahenge.
inviteHint: Member ka DukaanSet account hona chahiye aur private single-use invitation accept karna hoga.
inviteSent: Configured email channel se invitation taiyar ho gaya.
permissionDenied: Aapka role yeh module nahi khol sakta
featureDisabled: Is shop ke liye yeh feature band hai
passwordChanged: Password badal gaya. Phir sign in karo; purane sessions band ho gaye.
verifyHint: Shop setup se pehle email par aaye single-use link se verify karo.
verificationSent: Verification request ho gayi. Configured email channel dekho.
legacyEmail: Email abhi verify nahi hai. Purane local account ka access bana hai.
deliveryLocal: Local preview: email links is computer ke private outbox mein saved hain. Live email delivery connected nahi hai.
forgotHint: Private single-use reset link ke liye email daalo.
resetRequested: Matching account ho to reset instructions uske email channel par dekho.
resetHint: Yeh link 30 minutes mein expire hota hai aur ek baar use hota hai.
invalidLink: Link missing, expired ya use ho chuka hai. Naya link maango.
registrationHint: Pehle kuch details. Email verify karne ke baad shop setup karo.
setupStep: Shuru Karne Ke Liye Taiyar Hai
quickSetupHint: Inventory setup optional hai. Jab chaaho products jod sakte ho.
acceptHint: Invited account mein sign in karo, phir is business mein join hona confirm karo.
ruleHint: Recorded demand, stock, 30-day sales aur pending drafts ke rules. Requests pakke orders nahi hain.
noMatch: Reorder se pehle sahi catalogue product banao ya match karo.
saveError: Save nahi hua. Request sambhal kar rakho aur phir try karo.
frozen: Save ka result pakka nahi hai. Edit band hai; yahi request phir bhejo.
permissionSummary: Contact permission sirf is request ke liye hai.
importHint: CSV check karke 100 tak naye products jodo. Zaroori columns: name, unit, price (₹). Optional: sku, cost (₹), stock, min_stock, variant. Stock opening inventory banta hai, sale nahi. Purane products nahi badalte. Dukaan ki feature settings lagu hain.
importInvalid: 256 KB aur 100 rows tak valid CSV chuno. Columns, quantity aur rupee amounts check karo.
importFirstRows: Pehli 12 rows dikhti hain. Confirm karne par file ki saari reviewed rows import hongi.
importSaved: Products aur opening stock import ho gaye.
readyFollowUps: Customer Se Baat Kar Sakte Hain
question: Aapke Karobar Ka Sawaal
aiAnswer: AI Ki Samajh — Apne Hisaab Se Check Karo
aiSharing: Sawaal aur dukaan ka chhota summary configured OpenAI service ko jaata hai. Phone, email, passwords aur photos nahi bhejte. Assistant aapka hisaab badal nahi sakta.
aiUnconfigured: Live AI service judi nahi hai. Upar ke summaries aapke saved records aur simple rules se hain.
aiUnavailable: AI service available nahi hai. Saved records ka summary dekh sakte hain.
aiRecordedOnly: Live AI juda nahi hai. Darj totals ke liye “aaj ki bikri kitni hai” ya “aaj ka kharcha kitna hai” poochhein. Is summary ka data AI provider ko nahi bheja jaata.
emailInstruction: Ek baar istemaal hone wala yeh link khol kar action confirm karein:
emailExpiryReset: Yeh link 30 minute mein expire hoga.
emailExpiryOther: Yeh link 24 ghante mein expire hoga.
emailSafety: Agar aapne request nahi ki, ise ignore karein. Yeh link kabhi share na karein.
followupMessage: Namaste {{name}}, jo {{item}} aapne poocha tha woh {{business}} mein phir mil raha hai. Abhi bhi chahiye toh reply karein.
